title: cute but useless
text: cute but useless. This is every bit as cute as it is completely and utterly useless. I don't think this thing could pick up a speck of dust if you attached it to a full sized vacuum, but it is cute if you like ladybugs. It is more of a paperweight than a cleaning tool though, I am afraid.
